label: ILLUSTRATIVE: hypothetical shocks for the SYNTHETIC demo business, not forecasts
description: Judge's Challenge on CASCADE (issue #123): named surprise shocks a judge can throw at the SYNTHETIC demo business. Each shock is a core.financials.ScenarioShock built from explore_shock_guidance.json parameters with that file's mapping_to_scenario_shock, and every parameter lies inside the cited category's [min, max]. The shocks are inputs; every number shown for them comes from POST /api/simulate (SIMULATED).
surprise_me: Deterministic: 'Surprise me' steps through surprise_order in sequence (pick k uses entry (k - 1) mod n) and shows the pick number. No hidden randomness.

not_included.reason: ScenarioShock has no receivables-timing field (the demo business is paid at the till); mapping it to a demand drop would misstate the cash effect.
